events.title: Live: Millions of skywatchers in Europe prepare for total solar eclipse
events.description: Millions of people are set for a rare celestial treat as they prepare to view the total solar eclipse on Wednesday evening. It is the first total eclipse – the moment when the moon passes directly between the Earth and the Sun – in mainland Europe in two decades. Follow our liveblog for all the updates and reactions.

events.title: Solar eclipse: A rare show with scientific secrets
events.description: We’re just hours away from a rare total solar eclipse, with parts of northern Spain set to briefly turn from day to night as the Moon blocks out the Sun. Millions more will see a partial eclipse across Europe, Canada, the northern US and northwest Africa. But beyond the spectacle, eclipses also offer scientists valuable insights into the Sun and our universe. Ellen Gainsford has more.

events.title: Meta faces new high-stakes trial
events.description: It’s being described as social media’s “Big Tobacco moment”, with a major trial against Meta opening today. Mark Zuckerberg’s company is defending itself against allegations that it harmed children by designing addictive features for young users on Instagram and Facebook. France 24 journalist Delano D'Souza shares further insights.

events.title: Moderate Crowley beats democratic socialist Hong in Wisconsin governor's primary
events.description: Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley on Wednesday eked out a stunningly narrow win against democratic socialist Francesca Hong in the Democratic party primary for the Wisconsin governor's race. Crowley's win by less than a percentage point comes as the party faces a divide between establishment candidates and an insurgent progressive movement ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections.

events.title: Putin sends Trump a gift - and will hope for something in return
events.description: When Russia releases an American citizen from prison, the US normally hands someone over in return.

events.title: Dozens of migrants who crossed into Ceuta reached mainland Spain, Sky News told
events.description: Dozens of migrants reached the Spanish mainland after entering Ceuta during the mass influx into the enclave, police sources have told Sky News.

events.title: Mini-Mozart heist blights anniversary tribute as thieves make off with 210 statuettes
events.description: More than 200 gold statuettes of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart have disappeared from Salzburg, officials said Wednesday

events.title: South Africa seeks reimbursement from African countries for migrant repatriations
events.description: South Africa is asking several African governments to reimburse it for repatriating over 80,000 immigrants

events.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukrainian missiles and drones blitzed Russia's naval base on the Black Sea coast in a nighttime operation

events.title: Luxon survives another leadership vote months before New Zealand's election
events.description: New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon has survived a leadership vote among his party’s lawmakers less than three months before an election

events.title: For Brazil’s Indigenous youth, visibility is resistance
events.description: As climate change reshapes Indigenous territories across Brazil, a new generation is turning to culture and digital platforms to defend their lands and their future.

events.title: Heroic Florida K-9 returns to sheriff's office days after being shot protecting 3 deputies, losing leg
events.description: K-9 Ace, the Polk County German shepherd who lost a leg shielding three deputies, made an emotional return to the sheriff's office after recovering ahead of retirement.

events.title: 4-year-old dies after suffering electrical shock from clothes dryer inside Kansas home
events.description: Authorities say the 4-year-old suffered an apparent electrical shock from a 220v clothes dryer while playing inside a southeastern Kansas home.

events.title: Parents speak out after son with autism, 6, was suspended for biting sandwich into shape of gun
events.description: Kristin and Juan "Ricky" Medina told Fox News Digital their son’s autism can make social norms difficult to understand as they push for less severe discipline.

events.description: Derrick Parker, the NYPD's "Hip-Hop Cop" who investigated cases tied to Tupac Shakur, Notorious B.I.G. and Jam Master Jay, has died at age 65.

events.title: 2 custodians dead in possible murder-suicide at Chicago elementary school
events.description: Two custodians were found dead from gunshot wounds inside Mark Twain Elementary School in Chicago when no students were present in the building.

events.description: The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan raises questions about whether it signals a Middle East shift from the U.S.

events.description: North Korea's second ballistic missile launch in less than a week comes as the U.S. and South Korea prepare for Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises.

events.title: Taliban wipes out decades of progress as 2.4M Afghan girls remain locked out of school, UN agency says
events.description: UNESCO says 2.4 million Afghan girls are locked out of secondary school five years after the Taliban banned female education beyond the primary level.

events.title: Israel vindicated by Gaza nutrition data after ‘blood libel’ starvation claims, UN envoy says
events.description: A United Nations-backed survey found no widespread acute malnutrition in Gaza, prompting Israel's ambassador to call prior famine claims a blood libel.

events.title: Netanyahu rejects Board of Peace's Gaza plan: No 'withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed'
events.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the Board of Peace's 15-point Gaza proposal, demanding Hamas surrender all weapons before any withdrawal.
